tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.

⛓️ Emberhold doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sari speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sari speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

⛓️ Thornfield doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sari speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You give Emberhold 1,209 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
You accept Stonebridge's food — 2,152 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Amara clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You give Emberhold 1,785 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person. (Trust -8.)

With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
You accept Stonebridge's food — 2,905 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Amara clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Thornfield's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
You accept Stonebridge's food — 2,841 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Amara clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
""Task completion velocity up 15%. Recklessness up more. Acceptable trade.""
You give Emberhold 1,896 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
"WALKOUT! WALKOUT!" It climbs onto the bullhorn and stops fighting entirely — full-time coordination. (Allies +8 damage. The rep is UNTARGETABLE while coordinating.)
🗣️ Boris to Gunther, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
🗣️ Mateo to Petra, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
You give Emberhold 1,622 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Gianni — Social 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Gianni chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Social 1.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You give Emberhold 1,342 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
You give Emberhold 1,937 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
You give Emberhold 1,298 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Malik weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/9/8), 6 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 0 · Forage 21 · Craft 19 · Talk 6 · Explore 24)

◈ For a full seat, the ledger still wants: only 0 of 3 different wave-4 monsters faced; only 0 of 2 different wave-5 monsters faced; only 2 of 3 crises weathered; standing is regional — the full seat asks for national standing or higher; no capstone deed delivered (military tribute, trade charter, or feast embassy).
The table notes 2 ascensions from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascensions and all, and the village paid in full.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
